title: Platform and applied solution
goal: Identify the system you are opening and explain why installing the platform does not create a working service desk.
prerequisites: Open a folder and create a text file.
outcomes: Separate platform, configuration and data using a concrete example.
Distinguish developing a learning application from operating real business records.
Choose a free learning path and explain its limits.
sections: “Install 1C” is an incomplete specification. The platform supplies common mechanisms: windows, infobase access, module execution and data operations. A configuration describes a domain: which customers, requests and services exist, what can be saved and how results are calculated. An infobase holds a particular application instance and its data. Several infobases can use one installed platform. A shortcut label therefore does not establish that the intended infobase is open.

In our service desk, Request as a future document type belongs to the configuration. Request REQ-001 from invented customer Alpha is data. Version 8.3.27.2214 identifies the platform. Confusing these layers can make you mistake a software update for a data transfer or submit configuration sources instead of completed work. Separate the layers before making your first change.

The platform does not inherently know what “request closed” means. The application defines that rule. Identical words in different configurations may represent different actions. Saving generally persists an object state; posting reflects a business event according to configuration rules. Posting does not automatically mean payment or completion. A1 establishes vocabulary and a model; actual catalogs and documents are introduced in later modules.

The learning model contains three requests lasting 30, 45 and 30 minutes. Their sum is 105 minutes, but this is not yet revenue, employee workload or paid labor: we have not defined those rules. A careful user checks the meaning, unit and selection behind a metric before drawing conclusions. This habit is more useful than memorizing button positions.

The official training edition supports creating configurations and practicing without a purchase. Its limitations include file mode, a single session and restricted data volumes; user passwords and operating-system authentication are unavailable. Consequently, entering without a password in this edition proves nothing about production security. All course records are invented.

Community licensing is a different official development path. The official page specifies platform 8.3.23 or later and registration with phone verification. It does not authorize operating a learning workspace for real management or accounting. Free acquisition does not mean permission to repackage the installer in Nexus. Basic A1 needs only a file-based training workspace, without a server or purchased license.
Record a result that can be checked

Record the application name, a safe infobase alias and the full platform version separately. A configuration version does not replace a platform version. An unlabeled screenshot does not explain the operation tested. A concise protocol includes the action, expected result, observed result and limits of the conclusion.

Without an installed platform, you can study theory and classify items with the interactive diagram. This is useful preparation, but it is not 1C execution. Diagram buttons explain a model; they do not create an infobase or execute BSL. Attest a laboratory step only after observing it in the official environment.

walkthrough.expected: 8.3 is an incomplete platform version; Desk-A is an infobase instance; REQ-001 is data.
Defining the field and allowed values changes configuration; selecting one request status changes data.
3 requests; 105 minutes; 1 New request. These counts describe only the synthetic set.

exercises.task: Classify six items: executable version, Request type, REQ-001, Status attribute, customer Alpha record, module execution mechanism.
exercises.criteria: Platform: version/mechanism; configuration: type/attribute; data: request/customer.

exercises.task: Explain why copying Configuration.xml does not transfer the three requests.
exercises.criteria: Identify structure, separate records and an appropriate infobase backup method.

exercises.task: Explain two possible reasons for a 75-minute report when source durations sum to 105.
exercises.criteria: For example, a filter excludes the closed request, or the report measures something else. Propose a check for each.

lab.title: Your first environment record
lab.environment: Official platform. Baseline Windows training target: 8.3.27.1508; automated probe tested on 8.3.27.2214. These are different evidence scopes.
steps: Open only the dedicated learning infobase; if none exists, use A1.4 to create it.
Open About and record full platform version and application name.
Describe expected project data separately, without presenting the Nexus model as actual infobase contents.
expected: Full platform version and a safe learning-infobase name.
Three correct examples separating platform, configuration and data.
evidence: Environment record without personal or licensing information.
lab.negative: If an unknown production infobase is open, make no changes; return to creating a separate workspace.

mistakes: “No requests means the platform is broken”
An empty infobase does not contain the service desk configuration; inspect the application first.
“Free means I can redistribute the installer”
Use and redistribution are different rights; follow the official download link.

quiz.question: Where is the rule “status has three allowed values” defined?
quiz.explanation: Configuration defines domain rules; a record stores one value.

quiz.question: What can the Nexus diagram demonstrate?
options: Understanding the model when correctly explained
quiz.explanation: It is a visualization and does not call the platform.

quiz.question: What is 30 + 45 + 30 minutes?
quiz.explanation: Keep the unit and do not invent an economic meaning.

review: Explain the layers to a beginner.
